params.blurb: {{sbc|Toggle:}} {{ci|Singed}} continually creates a toxic cloud that shortly lingers in his wake, which continually inflicts {{tip|poison}} to enemies within.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|{{tip|poison|nolink=true}}:}} The target continually takes {{as|magic damage}} over a short time. Subsequent inflictions refresh the duration.
params.description:
{{sbc|Toggle:}} '''Singed''' continually creates a toxic cloud in his wake that lingers for {{fd|3.25}} seconds. The cloud inflicts {{tip|poison}} to enemies within.

''Poison Trail'' is toggled off automatically if '''Singed''' becomes unable to pay its {{sti|{{as|mana}}}} cost.
params.description2: {{sbc|{{tip|poison|nolink=true}}:}} The target takes {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds over 2 seconds as well as upon being hit if not currently affected. Subsequent inflictions refresh the duration.
params.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|20/4 to 60/4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|42.5/4}}% AP)}}|Magic Damage per Second|{{ap|20 to 60}} {{as|(+ {{fd|42.5}}% AP)}}|Minimum Magic Damage|{{ap|(20/4)*8 to (60/4)*8}} {{as|(+ {{ap|(42.5/4)*8}}% AP)}}}}
params.description3: '''Singed''' earns the kill credit of enemy {{tip|minions}} that are {{tip|poison|poisoned}} and would die to the damage of allied minions within the time before the next damage instance.
params.notes:
* Toggled abilities do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
* When ''Poison Trail's'' debuff is applied instead of refreshed, the target is dealt one additional instance of the debuff at the same time as the application. This is done by delaying the actual debuff by {{fd|0.1}} seconds.
** If the target is already affected by the debuff, its duration is refreshed to the maximum (2 seconds).
* While active after spawning, a cloud checks for valid targets who remain in or re-enter a cloud every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
** Valid targets already afflicted with the poison will have their debuff's duration refreshed every {{fd|0.25}} seconds if applicable.
* If '''Singed''' has moved fewer than 90 units since spawning the last poison cloud, it will spawn 35 units in front of him. They also only spawn every 1 second in this case. 
** When '''Singed''' is moving faster than that, the poison clouds spawn more frequently and on top of himself.

description3.plain: Singed earns the kill credit of enemy minions that are poisoned and would die to the damage of allied minions within the time before the next damage instance.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Singed}} creates a field of adhesive at the target location for a short time that {{tip|ground|grounds}} and {{tip|slows}} enemies within.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Singed''' spills a potent adhesive that lands at the target location after {{fd|0.375}} seconds, creating a field for 3 seconds that {{tip|ground|grounds}} enemies within and {{tip|slows}} them.
params.notes:
* The goo missile is a projectile. It has a fixed travel time but is independent from when the zone is established. It is destructible by effects such as {{ai|Wind Wall|Yasuo}} and will destroy item spell shields if the goo missile is thrown past an enemy champion.
* ''Mega Adhesive's'' {{tip|slow}} and {{tip|ground}} debuffs are each marked as non-dispellable, so they are not removed by most {{tip|cleanse|cleanses}}. Each is however allowed to be removed by cleanses that '''also''' grant immunity to the debuff type, such as {{cai|Ragnarok|Olaf}}.

blurb.plain: Active: Singed creates a field of adhesive at the target location for a short time that grounds and slows enemies within.

description.plain: Active: Singed spills a potent adhesive that lands at the target location after 0.375 seconds, creating a field for 3 seconds that grounds enemies within and slows them.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Singed}} {{tip|airborne|flings}} the target enemy, dealing {{as|magic damage}} based on {{as|their '''maximum''' health}}.
params.blurb2: If the target lands on ''{{ai|Mega Adhesive|Singed}}'', they are briefly {{tip|root|rooted}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Singed''' {{tip|airborne|flings}} the target enemy 550 units over himself over {{rutngt|0.666}}, dealing {{as|magic damage}}. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped at 300 against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}.
params.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|50 to 90}} {{as|(+ {{ap|6 to 8}}% of target's '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|(+ 55% AP)}}}}
params.description2: If the target lands on ''{{ais|Mega Adhesive|Singed}}'' area of effect after the displacement, they are {{tip|root|rooted}} for a duration.
params.notes:
* During ''Fling'' cast time (the windup not during the actual fling) the enemy's flash is already locked, making it a non reactable spell.
* ''Fling'' can throw enemies over walls (circumstances permitting).
* {{tip|Slow-immune}} enemies will not be {{tip|root|rooted}} when ''flung'' into {{ai|Mega Adhesive|Singed}}.
* ''Fling'' is special cased to not {{tip|airborne|fling}} {{ci|Warwick}} while '''Singed''' is {{tip|suppression|suppressed}} by {{ai|Infinite Duress|Warwick}} after the cast time.
{{Unit-targeted cancel conditions}}
params.tips: * '''Singed''' may successfully issue a basic attack against the target of ''Fling'' while it is mid-air.
